title: Active-drainage prescribed-head storage / bottom / non-bottom derivative decomposition

activation_rule.required_parent_outcome: MAP09 reference prescribed-head corrector admitted with mass-complete whole-window candidate
activation_rule.selection: Choose the smallest delta for which both -delta and +delta are participant-status 0 in the unchanged MAP09 fixed-offset characterization.
activation_rule.no_valid_pair: Close MAP09A as BLOCKED_NO_PREREGISTERED_SYMMETRIC_PAIR. Do not search additional heads.

fixed_physics.drainage_tables: same frozen two-level tabulated PUB-GC E6 tables

derivatives.units: dimensionless metre-water per metre-head after native cm-to-m conversion
derivatives.interpretation: From DeltaS = B_nonbottom_net_in - E_bottom_out, so dB_nonbottom_net_in/dH = J_S + J_R.

no_required_identity: Do not require J_nonbottom to be nonzero.

gates: Activation rule is satisfied without adaptive head search.
Both selected prescribed-head corrector trials are valid from immutable origin and discarded afterward.
Both mass ledgers are complete and |mass_residual| <= 1e-10 cm.
storage_change = total_in - total_out within 1e-10 cm at both heads.
All three centered derivatives J_S, J_R and J_nonbottom are finite.
Committed authority remains revision/time zero and interface ledger count zero.
characterization_only: Whether J_S+J_R differs materially from the MAP03 drainage-free zero response.
Relative relation of J_S and J_R to production u.
interpretation_rules: A nonzero J_nonbottom in this fixture is evidence that the MAP03 storage/bottom cancellation is process-specific; because other optional head-dependent processes are disabled, active lagged drainage is the intended non-bottom mechanism.
A near-zero J_nonbottom would show that active drainage is present but does not materially change the local finite-window head derivative at the selected pair.
Neither result changes production ownership or slope policy without a separate coupling-level qualification.
forbidden: do not infer a universal drainage Jacobian from one fixture
